understanding.goal_understanding: Progress through KA59’s levels by positioning every selectable piece onto the goal tiles marked with '+' so that all goals are occupied simultaneously to trigger WIN for the level, continuing until the final level is cleared.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn controls the currently selected piece (identified by player.id/position) on a grid where cell spacing corresponds to 3 pixels; MOVE actions attempt to shift the selected piece one cell in the chosen direction, sometimes pushing an adjacent pushable object (block) if it is directly in the movement direction and can be displaced. Walls and boundaries can block or alter movement depending on their specific behavior. If multiple selectables exist, CLICK with an exact pixel coordinate matching another selectable’s listed position switches control to that piece. Movement blocked flags are only hints about adjacency and do not guarantee success or failure.
